assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.1.4 ships a `todowrite` tool, OFF by default: its TodoTool plugin adds it only when the config's `experimental.todo` is true (read from the binary's bundled source; probed: a project-local `{"experimental": {"todo": true}}` made it available to an API session, and the local model called it six times in one turn — `/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/todo1.log`, session ses_e43f67908ffeKem89OZv1IwzMl, whose rows are the fold's test fixture). Each call is a tool item whose `state.input.todos` is the whole list, the 1.x shape.

What irrlicht observes: the turn's arc (working through the tool loop, ready at the end) AND the list. #2109 P5b-2 added the 2.x fold (the maintainer's Q3): parser_v2.go hands each todowrite item to the same reconciler 1.x uses, so the session's `tasks` carry each item and its status. The replay golden pins the tasks; events.jsonl carries no task_delta for opencode (its store fold does not set AppliedTaskDeltas — the V1 column's 2-3 recording has none either).
caveats: The tasks are pinned by the golden, not by events.jsonl: the opencode store fold records no task_delta event (V1's 2-3 has 0).

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
the 2.x todowrite fold's red-first tests over a store-derived fixture (testdata/v2-todowrite.rows.sql)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
settings enable the experimental todowrite tool (`experimental.todo: true`) and deny the shell in RUN_CWD/opencode.json

script.text: Use your todo list (the todowrite tool) to track three short work items, updating each item's status (pending → in_progress → completed) as you make progress. Do NOT spawn any subagent. Then reply with exactly the word: done

verify: working across every todowrite step, never waiting
the golden's tasks list the items with their last statuses
